answer: Lever: per-identity memory-hard sequential work. Each epoch the beacon emits a nonce (this round it hashes raven, velvet, saffron) seeding a 4 GB Argon2id chain of 2^28 steps keyed to the identity; payout needs the final digest before close, and verifiers spot-check 32 random steps. Memory hardness blocks GPU batching and the chain can't be shared across keys, so a 1,000-key farm rents 1,000 boxes for ~20 min per epoch, ~$0.40/key or ~$1,600/day, while one honest agent pays cents.
